- Working knowledge of project planning and project management methods and tools.
- Supervisory experience, including leading diverse teams and management of multiple projects simultaneously.

- Prior financial crime consulting experience
- Detail oriented with the ability to multitask and quickly adapt to changing assignments

Crowe’s NetSuite consulting practice helps organizations transform their finance and operational systems through the implementation and optimization of Oracle NetSuite ERP, a leading cloud-based enterprise resource planning platform. Our team works with clients across a range of industries to design, implement, and support scalable ERP solutions that improve financial visibility, streamline operations, and enable data-driven decision-making.

Our professionals combine deep accounting and operational expertise with technical NetSuite capabilities—including financial modules, workflows, reporting, integrations, and automation—to deliver end-to-end implementations and process improvements. About the Role
Crowe seeks a NetSuite Implementation Senior Consultant to support ERP implementations for Manufacturing and Distribution clients. This role works directly with clients and project teams throughout implementation engagements, helping translate business requirements into effective NetSuite solutions. You will contribute across the full implementation lifecycle, including discovery, design, configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.

The ideal candidate combines ERP consulting experience with strong NetSuite functional knowledge and an understanding of supply chain processes. Experience supporting manufacturing operations, inventory management, supply chain, order management, and related business processes is highly valued.

This role requires strong client-facing and problem-solving skills, along with the ability to manage key project responsibilities and deliver high-quality work with limited oversight. You will collaborate with client stakeholders across finance, operations, supply chain, warehouse, and production teams to understand business needs, configure solutions, and support successful implementations. Together with Crowe’s project teams, you will help design scalable NetSuite solutions that improve operational efficiency, streamline processes, and enhance inventory visibility.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead NetSuite solution design across all core and advanced modules (Financials, Advanced Inventory, WMS, Advanced Manufacturing), ensuring business needs are met through scalable configuration and best-fit system architecture.
- Own functional configuration of NetSuite, including workflows, saved searches, dashboards, custom forms, roles, and permissions – without performing hands-on coding, but with a strong understanding of SuiteScript, Suitelets, and SuiteCloud architecture to guide technical teams effectively.
- Collaborate with integration leads to design and validate data flows and interface architecture between NetSuite and external systems, including field mapping, API methods (SuiteTalk/RESTlet), and middleware approaches (e.g., Celigo, Boomi).
- Evaluate and recommend solution approaches (standard vs. custom vs. SuiteApp) during design workshops and RTM reviews, balancing implementation speed, cost, and long-term maintainability.
- Support the development of Functional Design Documents (FDDs) and ensure alignment between functional requirements, system design, and technical specifications throughout the build lifecycle.
- Act as a solutioning lead during Design Phase, partnering with functional consultants to drive business process mapping, gap-fit assessments, and solution documentation aligned to PE-backed client scaling needs.
- Provide configuration oversight and quality assurance, reviewing proposed scripts, workflows, custom records, and data models for adherence to Crowe and NetSuite standards.
- Serve as a cross-functional escalation point for architecture or solution design decisions, ensuring technical feasibility and stakeholder alignment across workstreams.

Qualifications
Education
- Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Supply Chain, Engineering, or related field
- NetSuite Certifications – Suite Foundations, Administrator and ERP Consultant required.

Experience:
- 4+ years of NetSuite experience with a focus on solution design, module architecture, or technical oversight roles.
- Prior experience in multi-entity, multi-currency, or fast-scaling environments.
- Strong expertise across core modules (GL, AR/AP, Procurement, Inventory, Fulfillment, Manufacturing).

Proficiencies:
- Deep knowledge of NetSuite Advanced Modules: Advanced Inventory Management, Warehouse Management System (WMS), Advanced Manufacturing.
- Understanding of NetSuite’s platform architecture including SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, SuiteTalk, and Suite Analytics.
- Ability to read, review, and advise on SuiteScript 2.x design patterns and SuiteCloud development best practices.
- Familiarity with 3rd-party integration frameworks, connector platforms (e.g., Celigo, Boomi), and data mapping processes.
- Experience using AI tools (e.g., prompt engineering, low-code development tools) is a plus.

Key Skills & Competencies
- Systems thinking with an ability to architect holistic ERP + integration solutions.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills to articulate technical decisions to functional and non-technical audiences
- Ability to lead and influence both Crowe implementation teams and client stakeholders.
